subject.title: WhatsApp QR-unavailable/headless login needs phone-code fallback

question: Should WhatsApp phone-code login be exposed through the generic channel login contract and `channels login --phone-number`, or should the entrypoint stay WhatsApp-owned?
rationale: The requested fix crosses WhatsApp implementation, public CLI, plugin-facing channel auth API, and persisted auth-state behavior, so automation should not choose the permanent API shape alone.

options.title: Accept Generic Login Method After Proof
options.body: Keep the typed generic login-method path, but require the Baileys pairing-code fix, QR compatibility, and live/upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Move To WhatsApp-Owned Surface
options.body: Rework the fallback so phone-code login is owned by the WhatsApp plugin without expanding the generic channel-auth contract.

options.title: Pause Until Dependency Path Is Proven
options.body: Keep this issue open but wait for stronger Baileys pairing-code proof or upstream hardening before committing to a public entrypoint.

recommendation.title: Accept Generic Login Method After Proof
recommendation.body: Keep the typed generic login-method path, but require the Baileys pairing-code fix, QR compatibility, and live/upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses public CLI, plugin/channel API, docs, and auth-session boundaries where recent history points to steipete as the strongest routing owner.
